name: OzISP
summary: Regional dialup ISP ('for Country Australia', unlimited hours/downloads, ~2001); ceased internet services Sep 2017 (UNIWARE MANAGED SERVICES PTY LTD, ACN 003 434 277).

events.details: Announced 'Withdrawal of Internet Services' 28/09/2017 (service announcement archived on ozisp.com.au); owner Uniware pivoted to managed IT (UNIWARE MANAGED SERVICES PTY LTD, ACN 003 434 277, ABN active).

refs.label: OzISP's own site carried a 28/09/2017 'Withdrawal of Internet Services' announcement
Domain now serves Uniware managed-IT site — no internet plans (403 to bots, 200 with browser UA)
Owner company survives as an IT/ERP services firm, not an ISP
ABR: UNIWARE MANAGED SERVICES PTY LTD ACN 003 434 277
